name: flatPlate_shelf_to_shelf
description: Dual-handover shelf-to-shelf: Robot-0 (finger gripper) extracts a flat plate from Shelf-A, hands it to Robot-1 (suction gripper) which carries it around the central wall via the +y side, then Robot-1 hands the plate back to Robot-0 (finger gripper) who inserts it into Shelf-B. The wall is tall enough and the RRT z-bound is low enough that the trajectory CANNOT go over the wall — it must route around through the suction gripper's workspace.

custom_objects.name: flatPlate
custom_objects._comment: Flat plate sitting vertically in Shelf-A slot

custom_objects.name: wallObstacle
custom_objects._comment: Central wall: x=±0.10, y=−0.55 to +0.35, z=0.60–1.60. Shifted toward −y and extended to completely block the front passage. Only the back corridor (y>+0.35) remains open, forcing the plate to detour through the suction gripper's workspace.

target_pose._comment: Vertical slot in Shelf-B (mirrored from Shelf-A)

planning._rrt_bounds_comment: z-max=1.45 gives enough lift space above the shelves (~1.15) for handover positions, while still 0.15m below wall top (1.60). y=±0.50 allows detour around wall (y=+0.35).
